scenario: Phase1 real Codex backend closure (AgentKernel + CodexRuntimeAdapter on managed-runtime image)

environment.gateway_chain: gateway router svc :8082 -> /agentengine/api/v1/{RunAgent,SubmitInteraction,GetAgentStatus,SubscribeSessionEvents} -> server (agentengine-kernel, server-signed permit) -> runtime /agent-kernel/v1/*

deployment.name: agent-runtime-codex-kernel
deployment.node: pinned to 10.0.2.11 (kubernetes.io/hostname) because default phase1 node 10.0.2.227 has no egress to the model gateway
deployment.model: glm-5.3 via https://kspmas-internal.sdns.ksyun.com/v1 (kspmas responses endpoint NOT supported; KSADK_CODEX_USE_PROXY=1 -> ksadk model_proxy responses->chat conversion, probe verdict recorded here)
deployment.note_secrets: model credentials in Secret codex-model-creds; api key row ak-phase1-codex; no values recorded here

a_real_model_run.final_state: kernel_runs.state=completed after 71 runtime/v2 events (real token deltas incl. Chinese final answer)
a_real_model_run.note_sse: gateway SSE stream closes early (before terminal) while events keep persisting; verified completion via DB seq space

detail.real_model_initiated_approval: not achieved - glm-5.3 (via proxy chat conversion) answered directly without invoking the shell tool despite sandbox_mode=read-only + approval_policy=on-request overrides and an explicit execute-command prompt; no requestApproval item materialized

manual_ledger_path.submit: SubmitInteraction approve accepted (receipt accepted, message_id d2465868-dfaa-4ca7-96f7-079cf5f730c2)
manual_ledger_path.outcome: worker submit_interaction handler rejected with typed control.command_rejected reason=unsupported (seq 46) because the target run had already completed - no live codex approval existed to answer; ledger row left pending/cancelled manually

detail.wiring_proven: public SubmitInteraction -> server admission -> durable inbox -> kernel worker submit_interaction handler (typed rejection), i.e. the full control chain is wired; live approve->resume continuation not demonstrated end-to-end

detail.kill: pod deleted <1s after RunAgent receipt accepted (message_id 94436bde-9e4b-4ca9-822c-21716c8dc92c)
detail.no_loss: old pod persisted seq 1-9 (accept/claim/run_transition x2/message_completed/run.started/continuation/items) before dying - message claimed, nothing lost
detail.gap: orphaned open run a1342633 wedged the session: takeover did NOT deterministically close it (RecoveryCoordinator failures are swallowed; codex attach seam is unavailable and ephemeral threads cannot resume), so the next accepted message (seq 10) sat unconsumed for minutes
detail.recovery_after_ops: after manually marking the orphan run interrupted, the worker immediately claimed the follow-up (seq 11-14) and completed a real model run 6cfc99b5 (run.progress deltas through completed)

repo_commits.agentengine-server: no code change; DB rows only (agents/phase1-codex-kernel-agent, agent_instances/codex-kernel-1, api_keys/ak-phase1-codex) + redis status reporter deployment

known_issues_found: readiness flap: sessions with completed runs stay in LeaseHeartbeat heartbeat_sessions without lease renewal; after lease TTL the /agent-kernel/v1/health lease_healthy flips false and server admission rejects with runtime_not_ready until pod restart
takeover recovery swallows exceptions and leaves orphaned running runs wedging the session (see check c)
gateway SubscribeSessionEvents closes the SSE stream before the terminal event while runtime events continue persisting

codex direct (non-proxy) mode with a custom OPENAI_API_BASE never configures a custom model_provider: probe=supported path sends turns to the default ChatGPT/OpenAI provider (model shows gpt-5.6-sol) - KSADK_CODEX_USE_PROXY=1 is required for custom upstreams
uv build reused stale build/ directory: wheel did not contain composition.py fix until build/ was removed; same-tag IfNotPresent node cache required digest pinning on redeploy
